title: Cookies
description: Advice4you uses only essential browser storage. No tracking and no advertising cookies.
content:
Cookie policy

Last updated: 2026-10-11

The short version

We do not use tracking or advertising cookies. This website only stores what it needs to work.

What we store

Language choice. Remembers the language you picked, so the next page opens in that language.

Cookie choice. Remembers your answer to the cookie message, so we do not ask again.

Both are stored in your browser on your own device. We cannot see them.

Optional cookies

We do not use any optional cookies today. If we add optional tools in the future, such as visitor statistics, they will only start after you say yes. You can change your choice at any time with the Cookie settings link at the bottom of every page.

Other websites

Links to other websites, such as GOV.UK or WhatsApp, take you to services with their own cookie rules.
